projects.title: AI-Based Head-Controlled Mouse with Voice Assistant
projects.description: An AI-powered assistive technology project designed to help people with physical disabilities control a computer without relying on a traditional mouse. Using a webcam and real-time facial landmark detection, the system translates head movements into cursor movements. It also supports blink-based clicking and voice-command integration for hands-free interaction. Built with Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, and PyAutoGUI, the project aims to improve digital accessibility, independence, and ease of computer use for people with limited hand mobility.

projects.title: FlowML – Visual AutoML Platform
projects.description:
FlowML is a visual AutoML platform designed to simplify machine learning through an intuitive drag-and-drop workflow builder. It aims to help users upload datasets, preprocess data, build ML pipelines, train and test models, and evaluate results through a unified interface. The platform also supports custom Python code integration, making machine learning more accessible to students, developers, and beginners. Built with a modern web interface and cloud deployment, FlowML focuses on simplifying the end-to-end machine learning workflow.

Key Features:
• Visual drag-and-drop ML workflow builder
• Dataset upload and preprocessing
• Machine learning model training and testing
• Model evaluation and result visualization
• Custom Python code support
• Web-based interface and cloud deployment
